authority: ENHANCEMENT E2 — creator/token denylist + trusted allowlist pre-filter, applied BEFORE the sub-10ms pre-trade safety gate (aats/risk/pretrade_gate.py).

HARD_RULES.denylist_can_only_reject: Every entry in `denylist.creators` / `denylist.mints` can ONLY cause a pre-gate REJECT. There is NO field here that sizes a trade, triggers a buy, widens a stop, or raises a cap. A denylist is structurally a veto — it can only DE-RISK / exclude.
HARD_RULES.allowlist_does_not_bypass_safety: `allowlist.creators` / `allowlist.mints` mark a candidate TRUSTED. Trust does NOT skip the safety gate: an allowlisted candidate STILL runs the full PreTradeSafetyGate (freeze/mint authority, LP lock, cluster/concentration, taxes, staleness). The allowlist only suppresses *manual operator denylist additions* you might later add by mistake — it never green-lights anything and is never a standalone buy trigger.
HARD_RULES.denylist_wins_ties: If a key appears in BOTH the denylist and the allowlist, the DENYLIST wins (fail-closed). Safety beats convenience, always.
HARD_RULES.slow_loop_only_curation: Curating this file (adding scam creators/mints) is a SLOW-LOOP / operator activity. It is read by the FAST path as already-resolved DATA (a frozen in-memory set), never computed on the hot path. The hot path does a single O(1) set membership test on the pre-resolved snapshot.
HARD_RULES.hot_reloadable: The file is HOT-RELOADABLE: the loader stat()s the file (mtime + size) on a throttled cadence and atomically swaps the in-memory snapshot when the file changes. A malformed reload is REJECTED and the previous good snapshot is retained (fail-safe: never widen the denylist by accident, never drop it because of a typo).
HARD_RULES.point_in_time: Membership is a property of the KEY (wallet/mint string), not of any future price. There is no compute-time leak: the same set membership test runs in live and in backtest. event_time is carried through purely so the reject reason can be stamped at the decision slot.
HARD_RULES.no_secrets: This file contains PUBLIC on-chain addresses only (creator wallets, token mints). No private keys, no API keys. Addresses are public information.
